label: Euclid/Euclid DR1/SPE/Models Galaxy Candidates (Deep)
name: Euclid DR1 SPE Models Galaxy Candidates - Deep
description: Euclid is a space-based survey observatory launched by the European Space Agency (ESA) in July 2023, which aims to map the large-scale structure of the Universe to better understand dark energy and dark matter. The first stage of Data Release 1 (DR1 Foundation) was released on 12 November 2026. This is the DR1 table spectro_model_spe_galaxy_models_deep from the SPE (spectroscopic redshifts and spectral features) products, with 36,936,097 rows, converted to HATS by IRSA.
